# Get-AvmBicepWorkflowModuleMatrix

## Synopsis

Build a deterministic Bicep module workflow matrix.

## Description

Selects existing top-level AVM Bicep modules from either explicit manual
paths or changed repository paths. Matrix entries include static, E2E,
and PSRule policy metadata from Get-AvmBicepWorkflowTestFiles. README
changes are ignored, and callers can also exclude metadata-only changes.
Paths are validated as literal repository-relative paths.

## Syntax

```powershell
Get-AvmBicepWorkflowModuleMatrix -Root <string> -ChangedFiles <string[]> [-ExcludeMetadataChanges] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]

Get-AvmBicepWorkflowModuleMatrix -Root <string> -ModulePaths <string> [-ExcludeMetadataChanges] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
Get-AvmBicepWorkflowModuleMatrix -Root $repo -ModulePaths 'avm/res/storage/storage-account'
```

### EXAMPLE 2

```powershell
Get-AvmBicepWorkflowModuleMatrix -Root $repo -ChangedFiles $changed -ExcludeMetadataChanges
```
